title: Dining Hall Leftover Food Waste Tracker
problem: Buckets of good rice and dal get thrown into trash bins every day in our hostel mess, while farmers in our villages work so hard to grow the grain.
idea: A waste tracker for our mess. The camera checks each plate as clean or wasted, and the screen shows how much food we throw away. Here you can check plates and also calculate our monthly waste.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What plate does the camera see?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine looks at each plate at the wash area. Tap a plate to see what the screen says.
widgets.question: A student brings this plate to the wash area:

options.label: Clean plate
options.result: Super! Clean plate. Thank you for respecting the farmer's work.
options.te: శుభ్రమైన పళ్ళెం! రైతు కష్టాన్ని గౌరవించినందుకు ధన్యవాదాలు.

options.label: Some rice left
options.result: A little food is left. Next time take a smaller serving first.
options.te: కొంచెం అన్నం మిగిలింది. తర్వాత ముందు కొంచెమే వడ్డించుకోండి.

options.label: Half plate wasted
options.result: Half the plate is wasted! Take only what you can eat. You can always ask for more.
options.te: సగం పళ్ళెం వృథా! తినగలిగినంతే తీసుకోండి. కావాలంటే మళ్ళీ అడగండి.

widgets.heading: 🧮 How much food do we waste in a month?
widgets.intro: Weigh the waste bucket after lunch and dinner. Enter the numbers here.

inputs.label: Cost of 1 kg cooked food (₹, approx.)

widgets.formula: if (typeof kg !== 'number' || typeof days !== 'number' || typeof price !== 'number') return null; if (kg < 0 || days <= 0) return null; var total = kg * days; var meals = Math.round(total / 0.4); var money = total * price; var level = kg <= 3 ? 'good' : (kg <= 10 ? 'warn' : 'bad'); return {total: total, meals: meals, money: money, days: days, level: level};

items.title: Take small first
items.text: Serve a small amount. Go back for a second helping if you are still hungry.
items.te: ముందు కొంచెం వడ్డించుకోండి. ఆకలైతే మళ్ళీ తీసుకోండి.

items.title: Tell the cooks
items.text: If a dish is too salty or too spicy, tell the mess captain kindly.
items.te: కూర ఉప్పు లేదా కారం ఎక్కువైతే మెస్ కెప్టెన్‌కి చెప్పండి.

items.title: Remember the farmer
items.text: One plate of rice needs many days of a farmer's hard work.
items.te: ఒక్క పళ్ళెం అన్నం వెనుక రైతు ఎన్నో రోజుల కష్టం ఉంది.

how: Open teachablemachine.withgoogle.com and choose Image Project.
Make 3 classes: Clean plate, Some food left, Lots of food wasted. Take about 50 photos for each class (ask friends to help).
Click Train, then Export and copy the model link.
Every day, weigh the waste bucket and write the kg in a notebook.
In Scratch (or PictoBlox), make a variable 'waste kg' and show it on a big screen with a farmer sprite.
Ask Gemini to write short no-waste messages and show one message each day near the plate wash area.
prompt: I am a Class 8 hostel student. Our mess throws away about 12 kg of food every day. Write 5 short, kind messages in simple English and Telugu to remind students to take only what they can eat and to respect farmers.
